problem_statement: Machine-learning based project integrating environmental and agricultural parameters to generate data-driven crop recommendations for decision support.
challenges: Dealing with noisy soil and climate data
Ensuring high classification accuracy across diverse crop types
outcomes: Built and validated a Random Forest model with 95% accuracy in crop recommendation.
lessons_learned: Feature scaling and normalization are critical when combining divergent variables like soil pH and rainfall values.
